description: Double Top Short Sell - stock rallies to prior high (resistance), fails to break through. Short on rejection.
notes: All expressions measured on scan_date (day before entry_date)
Entry candle data is NEVER used
LSP features computed for examples only (for validation), MAXH proxies used for universe scanning
Every numeric expression must be translatable to TC2000 PCF syntax

rule_1_near_resistance.concept: Price approaching or at prior high (MAXH proxies LSP for universe scanning)
rule_1_near_resistance.ta_ref: DTSS = second rally into same zone as prior high. LSP/MOC lines mark institutional resistance.

proximity_to_maxh.desc: (MAXH_N - C) / normalizer — how far below the recent high
proximity_to_maxh.note: Small values = near top. DTSS should be tight (< 1-2 ATR)

high_proximity_to_maxh.desc: (MAXH_N - H) / normalizer — did today's high touch the prior high

overshoot_maxh.desc: (H - MAXH_N.1) / normalizer — did today's high exceed yesterday's rolling max (marginal new high)

close_vs_maxh_pct.desc: C / MAXH_N — percentage of the high reached

range_narrowing_at_top.desc: (MAXH_N - MAXC_N) / ATR14 — gap between highest wick and highest close

rule_2_extension_from_mas.concept: Stock is extended above MAs (rallied up to resistance)
rule_2_extension_from_mas.ta_ref: Extension from 50 SMA in ADR multiples is the universal cycle indicator. Extension peaks cluster at stock-specific ceilings.

extension_adr.desc: (C - MA) / ADR14 — extension in ADR multiples (core TA metric)

extension_slope.desc: Change in extension over N bars: ((C - MA)/ADR14) - ((C.N - MA.N)/ADR14.N)
extension_slope.note: TA: declining extension slope = momentum stalling = stage 2b->3 transition

extension_peak.desc: (MAXH_N - MA) / ADR14 — peak extension reached recently

rule_3_ma_structure.concept: MA stacking and slopes confirm uptrend that brought stock to resistance
rule_3_ma_structure.ta_ref: Baby/daddy MAs (8/21 EMA), 50 SMA slope, MA stacking order

rule_4_momentum_stalling.concept: Rally losing steam — volume drying up, RSI diverging, ROC declining
rule_4_momentum_stalling.ta_ref: Volume spikes on failed attempt then dries up. MAs flattening or rolling over. Stage 2b->3 characteristics.

roc_deceleration.desc: ROC5 - ROC10 — is short-term momentum less than medium-term

volume_trend.desc: AVGV10 / AVGV50 — recent volume vs longer-term

raw_indicators.desc: RSI, ADX, CCI, Stochastic, MACD, BOP, CMF, Kaufman Efficiency values at scan bar
raw_indicators.note: Each returned as-is for threshold profiling

indicator_offsets.desc: Key indicators offset by N bars for trend detection

rule_5_range_and_channel.concept: Where price sits in its range, channel characteristics
rule_5_range_and_channel.ta_ref: Range position, channel slope (steeper channels more likely to snap), pullback depth

channel_slope.desc: Linear regression slope of close over N bars, as % per bar

bollinger_pctb.note: High values = near top of bands

rule_6_boolean_features.concept: CountTrue/SinceTrue/TrueInRow — bar-by-bar condition counting in PCF
rule_6_boolean_features.ta_ref: Captures MA stacking persistence, trend consistency, volume patterns over time windows

rule_7_lsp_validation.concept: Example-only features using actual LSP data to validate MAXH proxy and add setup-specific context
rule_7_lsp_validation.ta_ref: LSP = highest RVOL pivot on left side of chart. Institutional resistance level.
rule_7_lsp_validation.note: These features are computed for examples only. They validate that MAXH approximation captures the same signal and provide ground truth for what the distance-to-resistance should look like.

expressions.lsp_bars_back: bars between LSP date and scan date
expressions.lsp_bars_since_valley: bars between valley low and scan date
expressions.lsp_vs_maxh20: (LSP - MAXH20) / ATR14 — validate MAXH20 as LSP proxy
expressions.lsp_vs_maxh50: (LSP - MAXH50) / ATR14 — validate MAXH50 as LSP proxy
expressions.lsp_vs_maxh65: (LSP - MAXH65) / ATR14 — validate MAXH65 as LSP proxy
expressions.lsp_vs_maxh120: (LSP - MAXH120) / ATR14 — validate MAXH120 as LSP proxy
